"""保存旧实现的实际反例与运行身份，不启动诊断宿主。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round10-red'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
command = [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_windows_stress.py', '-v']
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
record = {'checked_head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip(),
          'working_tree_includes_new_regression': True, 'time_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
          'test_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'tests/test_windows_stress.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
for name, raw in [('stdout', result.stdout), ('stderr', result.stderr)]:
    (OUT / (name + '.txt')).write_bytes(raw)
    record[name] = {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
(OUT / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

"""固定R10实现的全套回归与只读拒绝，保留实际原字节。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round10-validation'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert head == 'e58d3ae6d8671a5f8f822aa2b0d0d80f37b93596'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
from benchmark import source_sha256
report = {'implementation_commit': head, 'source_fingerprint_schema': 'cloudleaf-source-v3', 'source_sha256': source_sha256(),
          'started_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'checks': [], 'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
commands = [
    ('diff', ['git', 'diff', '--check'], 0),
    ('status', ['git', 'status', '--short'], 0),
    ('fmt', ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'], 0),
    ('clippy', ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'], 0),
    ('workspace-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'], 0),
    ('doc-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'], 0),
    ('build-release', ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline'], 0),
    ('workspace-audit', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py'], 0),
    ('python-tests', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'], 0),
    ('dependency-audit', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/audit_windows_dependencies.py', '--audit-binary',
                         r'C:\Users\EDY\WebstormProjects\Cloudleaf\.local\audit-tool\bin\cargo-audit.exe', '--output', str(OUT / 'dependency-audit.json')], 0),
    ('pending-environment', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_windows_soak_admission.py', '--request',
                             'docs/acceptance/cl007-round10-environment.json', '--output', str(OUT / 'pending-admission.json')], 2),
]
for name, command, expected in commands:
    command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    row = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'expected_returncode': expected, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - start}
    for label, raw in [('stdout', result.stdout), ('stderr', result.stderr)]:
        path = OUT / (name + '-' + label + '.txt')
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        row[label] = {'file': path.name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    report['checks'].append(row)
    (OUT / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'expected': expected, 'seconds': row['seconds']}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode != expected:
        print(result.stdout.decode('utf-8') + result.stderr.decode('utf-8'), flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode or 1)

"""生成新的pending模板，保留Round 8/9原件。"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
folder = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance'
for suffix in ['environment', 'execution-authorization', 'runner-approval', 'application-record']:
    source = folder / f'cl007-round9-{suffix}.json'
    target = folder / f'cl007-round10-{suffix}.json'
    assert not target.exists()
    value = json.loads(source.read_bytes())
    if suffix == 'execution-authorization':
        value.update(schema_version=2, execution_identity_sha256=None)
        value['notice'] = '待用户核验完整运行identity并明确批准后填写；SHA不证明真人签署，不授权TSF。'
    elif suffix == 'environment':
        value['execution_identity_binding'] = {'schema_version': 2, 'execution_identity_sha256': None,
                                               'actual_identity_report_path': None}
        value['notice'] = 'Round 10待填环境请求；实际环境与授权尚未准备。实际授权须schema2并绑定完整运行identity。本表不授权执行或TSF。'
    elif suffix == 'runner-approval':
        value['environment_request']['path'] = 'cl007-round10-environment.json'
        value['notice'] = '实际目标机identity及schema2授权材料齐备后由用户另行批准；当前pending，不是实际批准。'
    else:
        value['execution_identity_sha256'] = None
        value['steps_source'] = 'cl007-round10-application-steps.md'
    target.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')

"""归档R10实际红测、检查与身份，历史原件保持不变。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007/round10'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
BASE = '1a05633c27c133bc0558b0fb955b0f916edb6b72'
IMPLEMENTATION = 'e58d3ae6d8671a5f8f822aa2b0d0d80f37b93596'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip() == IMPLEMENTATION


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def save(name, value):
    path = OUT / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


originals = {}
for folder, prefix in [(ROOT / '.local/round10-red', 'red'), (ROOT / '.local/round10-validation', 'validation'), (ROOT / '.local/round10-publication-failure', 'publication-failure')]:
    for path in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        name = prefix + '/' + path.name
        originals[name] = {'original_path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')}
        if path.suffix == '.json':
            save(name, json.loads(raw))
        else:
            target = OUT / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            text = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()).rstrip()
            target.write_text(text + ('\n' if text else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
save('raw-artifacts.json', {'encoding': 'utf8.encode reproduces original bytes; display may use normalized LF', 'files': originals})
validation = json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round10-validation/checks.json').read_bytes())
assert len(validation['checks']) == 11 and all(row['returncode'] == row['expected_returncode'] for row in validation['checks'])
reports = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', BASE, 'docs/reports']).decode().splitlines()
changed_reports = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--no-renames', '--name-only', BASE, '--', 'docs/reports']).decode().splitlines()
assert not set(changed_reports).intersection(reports)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', BASE, '--', 'crates', 'adapters', 'apps', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'data'])
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
from benchmark import source_sha256
assert source_sha256() == validation['source_sha256']
identity = {'implementation_commit': IMPLEMENTATION, 'source_fingerprint_schema': 'cloudleaf-source-v3', 'source_sha256': source_sha256(),
    'data_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'data/dictionaries/prototype.tsv').read_bytes()),
    'tools': {name: sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) for name in ['scripts/check_windows_soak_admission.py', 'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py', 'scripts/report_windows_soak.py']},
    'built_release_files': {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): {'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(path.read_bytes())}
                            for path in sorted((ROOT / 'target/release').iterdir()) if path.is_file() and path.suffix in ['.dll', '.exe']},
    'historical_reports_unchanged': len(reports), 'production_rust_and_data_unchanged': True,
    'new_long_run_or_loader_or_tsf_executed': False, 'new_performance_measurement': False,
    'scope': 'Workspace original byte fingerprint; Git normalized source is separately identified by full implementation commit.'}
save('identity.json', identity)
sources = []
for name in ['run_round10_red.py', 'run_round10_checks.py', 'prepare_round10_templates.py', 'record_round10_environment.py', 'publish_round10_evidence.py', 'publish_round10-before-pathfix.py', 'replay_round10_publication_failure.py', 'recover_round10_publication.py']:
    raw = (ROOT / '.local' / name).read_bytes()
    sources.append({'name': name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')})
save('runners.json', {'sources': sources})
save('provenance.json', {'published_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'design_commit': 'f940a6cdb7ed12a99e6c86875a2bee6bf541ddf0', 'red_test_commit': '241d4da',
    'implementation_commit': IMPLEMENTATION, 'historical_reports_unchanged': len(reports), 'raw_files': len(originals),
    'display_does_not_replace_original_bytes': True, 'reports_do_not_authorize_execution': True})
save('checksums.json', {'scope': 'Git LF publication bytes; raw captured bytes independently enveloped',
    'sha256': {path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()}})
print(json.dumps({'raw_files': len(originals), 'historical_reports': len(reports), 'identity': identity}, ensure_ascii=False))

"""保全归档工具的Windows实测路径长度失败，修正只读历史核验。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
old = root / '.local/publish_round10_evidence.py'
source = old.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
backup = root / '.local/publish_round10-before-pathfix.py'
assert not backup.exists()
backup.write_bytes(old.read_bytes())
partial = root / 'docs/reports/cl007/round10'
preserved = root / '.local/round10-publication-initial-output'
assert partial.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()) and not preserved.exists()
partial.rename(preserved)
replay = root / '.local/replay_round10_publication_failure.py'
replay.write_text(source.replace("ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007/round10'", "ROOT / '.local/round10-publication-replay-output'"), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', str(replay)], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
failure = root / '.local/round10-publication-failure'
failure.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(failure / 'stdout.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout)
(failure / 'stderr.txt').write_bytes(result.stderr)
record = {'original_error': 'WinError206: Windows command line length exceeded while passing all historical report paths',
          'original_scope': 'First failure retained in tool transcript; raw child streams below are an exact-logic replay with a new output directory',
          'original_tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(backup.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'replay_tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(replay.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'replay_returncode': result.returncode,
          'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(), 'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest(),
